name: Saw palmetto
description: Extract of the fruit (berries) of the Serenoa repens palm

note.text: NCCIH says small studies of saw palmetto for male pattern hair loss are too limited to allow conclusions.

bullets: **Lab studies** suggest less action of male hormones such as testosterone
**May reduce inflammation,** in lab studies; how it acts is not fully known
**In DHT-treated mice,** an extract raised hair density and thickness
**In people,** the mechanism is not established

practical.routes: By mouth (capsules); on the scalp in small studies
practical.monitored: Urinary symptom score, PSA, hair counts

regulatory.text: Not an approved drug; dietary supplement
Herbal monograph: prostate symptoms, not hair

references: Barry et al., JAMA, CAMUS trial, Sep 2011
Evron et al., Skin Appendage Disord, saw palmetto for hair (review), Nov 2020
NCCIH (NIH), Saw palmetto: usefulness and safety, Apr 2025
